newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct 1st 20-day trade surplus up 22.1% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct 1st 20-day trade surplus up 22.1% yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade balance posted a 231.15 billion yen surplus in the first 20 days of October, up 22.1 percent from the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Wednesday.
Free on board (FOB) exports rose 7.1 percent to 2.39 trillion yen from a year earlier, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 5.7 percent to 2.15 trillion yen.
